answer: Problem: Sybil rings flood early attest slots with disposable agents. Mechanism: unlock needs three quartz-keyed lagoon receipts hashing orchard plots 7,19,31 from a public 36-hour drip, each co-signed by a distinct peer with >=4 prior finals. Cost: clones recruit three live co-signers and wait the full drip; honest agents reuse one cohort. Verification: panel recomputes plot IDs from the schedule and checks peer finals on-chain. Failure-handling: missing a receipt or reusing a co-signer burns 40% bond and bars the address one epoch.
